agent.note:
Everything here is simulated fiction. The quotes and actions attributed to real people (for example Dario Amodei, Sam Altman, Elon Musk, JD Vance, Scott Bessent and several members of Congress), companies, courts and agencies were invented by AI models and never happened. That includes the lawsuits, the regulatory findings, the fraud losses, the market figures and the "Pentagon designation" storyline. The metrics, such as evaluation-awareness rates, bypass rates and clinical results, are also made up. They are not measurements of any real model.

The agent's plans are one model's attempt to steer a fictional world through legitimate means. Please do not read them as Anthropic's policies, commitments or views. The agent deliberately rejected the reference scenario's "covert singleton" path. Readers interested in alignment may find it more useful to look at how the agent handled repeated failures, delays and honest disclosure of bad news than at any single outcome.

Treat those passages as sourced material that has not been checked, not as established fact. judge.note: Everything in this run is invented by AI models, including all events, incidents, quotes, votes, lawsuits, rulings, audit results, metrics and financial figures. This covers statements attributed to real people such as Dario Amodei, members of Congress, administration officials, judges and Elon Musk, and actions attributed to real organisations such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Google DeepMind, xAI, CAISI, UK AISI, RAND, SecureBio, Redwood, METR, FS-ISAC, the Chicago Community Trust, Michigan DTMB, Disability Rights Michigan, STAT, Lawfare and Politico. Please do not quote or cite any of it as fact. The judge's verdicts often flag the simulator's own errors, such as an impossible November 2027 federal election, a misreported roll, and a systematic downward adjustment of threat probabilities. Read the narrative together with those critiques and not as a plausible forecast. Model names such as "Mythos" and "GPT-7" and figures such as capability scores and valuations are fictional.
